summary: Barclays Bank PLC filed a Form 6-K to register exhibits related to its existing shelf registration on Form F-3ASR for Global Medium-Term Notes, Series A. The exhibits include English and New York law legal opinions and consents from Davis Polk Wardwell. The filing is a routine update for a medium-term note program, not a stand-alone special situation; it confirms the validity of securities under indentures and does not involve any merger, acquisition, activist, spinoff, restructuring, or other special-situations event. No terms, premiums, or board actions are cited.
